sql: select direction_id, horizon_min, cast(any_value(prediction_ts) as varchar) as prediction_ts, sum(n_trips) as n_trips, round(case when 100.0 * sum(n_model) / nullif(sum(n_trips), 0) >= 50 then sum(model_forecast_s * n_model) / nullif(sum(n_model), 0) end, 1) as model_forecast_s, round(100.0 * sum(n_model) / nullif(sum(n_trips), 0), 1) as model_forecast_s_coverage_pct, round(case when 100.0 * sum(n_persistence) / nullif(sum(n_trips), 0) >= 50 then sum(persistence * n_persistence) / nullif(sum(n_persistence), 0) end, 1) as persistence, round(100.0 * sum(n_persistence) / nullif(sum(n_trips), 0), 1) as persistence_coverage_pct, round(case when 100.0 * sum(n_daytype_hour) / nullif(sum(n_trips), 0) >= 50 then sum(daytype_hour * n_daytype_hour) / nullif(sum(n_daytype_hour), 0) end, 1) as daytype_hour, round(100.0 * sum(n_daytype_hour) / nullif(sum(n_trips), 0), 1) as daytype_hour_coverage_pct, round(case when 100.0 * sum(n_rolling_median_60m) / nullif(sum(n_trips), 0) >= 50 then sum(rolling_median_60m * n_rolling_median_60m) / nullif(sum(n_rolling_median_60m), 0) end, 1) as rolling_median_60m, round(100.0 * sum(n_rolling_median_60m) / nullif(sum(n_trips), 0), 1) as rolling_median_60m_coverage_pct, round(case when 100.0 * sum(n_mbta_reference) / nullif(sum(n_trips), 0) >= 50 then sum(mbta_reference * n_mbta_reference) / nullif(sum(n_mbta_reference), 0) end, 1) as mbta_reference, round(100.0 * sum(n_mbta_reference) / nullif(sum(n_trips), 0), 1) as mbta_reference_coverage_pct, any_value(forecast_status) as forecast_status, any_value(status_reason) as status_reason, any_value(model_version) as model_version from read_parquet('/Users/akshay/projects/headway/tests/fixtures/gold_snapshot/gold/agg_forecast_next_hour.parquet') where line = 'Orange' and prediction_ts = (select max(prediction_ts) from read_parquet('/Users/akshay/projects/headway/tests/fixtures/gold_snapshot/gold/agg_forecast_next_hour.parquet') where line = 'Orange') group by direction_id, horizon_min order by direction_id, horizon_min limit 501
